examples.text: evaṃ, bhante. eso kho, bhikkhave, jarasiṅgālo ukkaṇṇakena nāma rogajātena phuṭṭho n'eva bilagato ramati, na rukkhamūlagato ramati, na ajjhokāsagato ramati, yena yena gacchati, yattha yattha tiṭṭhati, yattha yattha nisīdati, yattha yattha nipajjati, tattha tattha anayabyasanaṃ āpajjati.

14005.meaning2: having cut out; having cut off; having cut up; having butchered

14006.meaning2: 'finding food in a house ', perhaps a house-lizard, or vermin generally

14007.meaning2: going out; going away (from) going over; omitting; neglecting

examples.text: addasā kho bhagavā addhānamaggappaṭipanno aññatarasmiṃ padese mahantaṃ sālavanaṃ, disvāna maggā ukkamma yena taṃ sālavanaṃ ten'upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā taṃ sālavanaṃ ajjhogāhetvā aññatarasmiṃ padese sitaṃ pātv'ākāsi.

yassa kismiñci'd'eva ṭhāne maggā ukkamma nivattitvā paṭimaggaṃ ārohitu'kāmassa sato yaṃ ṭhānaṃ manussānaṃ sappaṭibhayaṃ, purato gantvā vañcetvā evaṃ karissāmī'ti na hoti, tatth'eva maggā ukkamma nivattitvā paṭimaggaṃ ārohati, ayaṃ vaṅko nāma.

14008.meaning1: what is dug up; diggings; debris

examples.text: yaṃ hoti kūlapaluggaṃ vā mūsik'ukkaro vā taṃ kājena āharitvā bhājanaṃ karitvā evam'āha, ettha yo icchati taṇḍulapaṭibhastāni vā muggapaṭibhastāni vā kaḷāyapaṭibhastāni vā nikkhipitvā yaṃ icchati taṃ haratū'ti.

ye'pi te paribbājakā ahesuṃ ukkalā vassabhaññā ahetukavādā akiriyavādā n'atthikavādā, te'pi imāni cattāri dhammapadāni na garahitabbaṃ na paṭikkositabbaṃ amaññiṃsu. taṃ kissa hetu? nindā-byārosana-upārambha-bhayā'ti

14010.meaning2: inhabitants of the country Ukkala (modern day Orissa)

examples.text: doṇamite sukhadukkhe pariyantakate saṃsāre, n'atthi hāyanavaḍḍhane, n'atthi ukkaṃsa-avakaṃse.

att'ukkaṃsakaparavambhakā, bhikkhave, nigaṇṭhā, sandiṭṭhiparāmāsā ādhānaggāhī duppaṭinissaggino, bhikkhave, nigaṇṭhā, kuhakā, bhikkhave, nigaṇṭhā, pāp'icchā, bhikkhave, nigaṇṭhā, pāpamittā, bhikkhave, nigaṇṭhā, imehi kho, bhikkhave, dasahi asaddhammehi samannāgatā nigaṇṭhā'ti.

14013.commentary: (MNa) so pana paribbājako etam'atthaṃ asallakkhetvā, mayhaṃ dassanaṃ saṃvaṇṇeti pasaṃsati, addhā me sundaraṃ dassanan'ti sallakkhetvā ukkaṃseti me bhavan'tiādim'āha.

examples.text: evaṃ vutte, dīghanakho paribbājako bhagavantaṃ etadavoca, ukkaṃsati me bhavaṃ gotamo diṭṭhigataṃ, samukkaṃseti me bhavaṃ gotamo diṭṭhigatan'ti.

14014.grammar: ind, adv, abl sg of ukkaṃsa
14014.construction:
ud + kaṃsa + a + to
ukkaṃsa + to

examples.text: upāhanā pana pabbajitassa yānaṃ'y'eva. ekabhikkhussa hi eko araññ'atthāya, eko dhotapādak'atthāyā'ti, ukkaṃsato dve upāhanasaṅghāṭā vaṭṭanti. tatiyaṃ labhitvā aññassa dātabbo.

ye kho keci samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā att'ukkaṃsakā paravambhī araññavanapatthāni pantāni sen'āsanāni paṭisevanti, att'ukkaṃsana-paravambhana-sandosahetu have te bhonto samaṇabrāhmaṇā akusalaṃ bhayabheravaṃ avhāyanti.

14017.meaning2: excess and deficiency; superiority and inferiority; maximum and minimum

14018.meaning1: excellence or deficiency; increase or decrease; superiority or inferiority

examples.text: doṇamite sukhadukkhe pariyantakate saṃsāre, n'atthi hāyanavaḍḍhane, n'atthi ukkaṃs'āvakaṃse.
ahaṃ kho'mhi uccākulā pabbajito, ime pan'aññe bhikkhū na uccākulā pabbajitā'ti. so tāya uccākulīnatāya attān'ukkaṃseti, paraṃ vambheti. ayaṃ, bhikkhave, asappurisadhammo.
n'ev'attān'ukkaṃsissāma na paraṃ vambhissāmā'ti
atha kho rājā māgadho ajātasattu vedehiputto pañcasu hatthinikāsatesu paccekā itthiyo āropetvā ārohaṇīyaṃ nāgaṃ abhiruhitvā ukkāsu dhāriyamānāsu rājagahamhā niyyāsi
maṃsapes'ūpamā kāmā vuttā bhagavatā bahudukkhā bah'upāyāsā, ādīnavo ettha bhiyyo. tiṇ'ukkā-upamā kāmā vuttā bhagavatā bahudukkhā bah'upāyāsā, ādīnavo ettha bhiyyo.

14022.commentary: (ANa) ukkaṃ bandheyyā'ti aṅgārakapallaṃ sajjeyya. (VISMa) ukkaṃ bandhatī'ti mūsaṃ sampādeti.

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, suvaṇṇakāro vā suvaṇṇakār'antevāsī vā ukkaṃ bandheyya, ukkaṃ bandhitvā ukkāmukhaṃ ālimpeyya, ukkāmukhaṃ ālimpetvā saṇḍāsena jātarūpaṃ gahetvā ukkāmukhe pakkhipeyya
yathā vā pana, mahārāja, brāhmaṇamāṇavakānaṃ… candaggāhaṃ sūriyaggāhaṃ sukkarāhucaritaṃ uḷuggahayuddhaṃ devadundubhissaraṃ okkanti ukkāpātaṃ… sikkhā karaṇīyā

14025.meaning1: trained in boastful talk; (comm) badly trained

examples.text: katamā tisso? ukkācitavinītā parisā, paṭipucchāvinītā parisā, yāvatāvinītā parisā, imā kho, bhikkhave, tisso parisā'ti.

14026.meaning2: holding up the torch; torch bearer

examples.text: evarūpā ca te, bhikkhave, bhikkhū satthāro'ti'pi vuccanti, satthavāhā'ti'pi vuccanti, raṇañ'jahā'ti'pi vuccanti, tamonudā'ti'pi vuccanti, ālokakarā'ti'pi vuccanti, obhāsakarā'ti'pi vuccanti, pajjotakarā'ti'pi vuccanti, ukkādhārā'ti'pi vuccanti, pabhaṅ'karā'ti'pi vuccanti, ariyā'ti'pi vuccanti, cakkhumanto'ti'pi vuccantī'ti. etam'atthaṃ bhagavā avoca.

te evarūpāya tiracchānavijjāya micchājīvena jīvitaṃ kappenti, seyyath'idaṃ… nakkhattānaṃ uppathagamanaṃ bhavissati, ukkāpāto bhavissati, disāḍāho bhavissati, bhūmicālo bhavissati, devadudrabhi bhavissati
yathā vā pana, mahārāja, brāhmaṇamāṇavakānaṃ… candaggāhaṃ sūriyaggāhaṃ sukkarāhucaritaṃ uḷuggahayuddhaṃ devadundubhissaraṃ okkanti ukkāpātaṃ… sikkhā karaṇīyā
seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, suvaṇṇakāro vā suvaṇṇakār'antevāsī vā ukkaṃ bandheyya, ukkaṃ bandhitvā ukkāmukhaṃ ālimpeyya, ukkāmukhaṃ ālimpetvā saṇḍāsena jātarūpaṃ gahetvā ukkāmukhe pakkhipeyya
seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, vatthaṃ saṃkiliṭṭhaṃ malaggahitaṃ acch'odakaṃ āgamma parisuddhaṃ hoti pariyodātaṃ, ukkāmukhaṃ vā pan'āgamma jātarūpaṃ parisuddhaṃ hoti pariyodātaṃ.

14030.meaning1: name of one of the sons of king Okkāka
14030.meaning2: name of one of the sons of king Okkāka

examples.text: bhūtapubbaṃ, ambaṭṭha, rājā okkāko yā sā mah'esī piyā manāpā, tassā puttassa rajjaṃ pariṇāmetu'kāmo jeṭṭhakumāre raṭṭhasmā pabbājesi, ukkāmukhaṃ karakaṇḍuṃ hatthinikaṃ sinipuraṃ.

14031.commentary: (THa) mahāukkārasambhavo'ti, ukkāro vuccati vaccakūpaṃ. yattakavayā mātā, tattakaṃ kālaṃ kāraparisedita-vaccakūpa-sadisatāya mātu kucchi idha mahāukkāro'ti adhippeto. so kucchi sambhavo uppattiṭṭhānaṃ etassā'ti mahāukkārasambhavo.

examples.text: nānākulamalasampuṇṇo, mahāukkārasambhavo, candanikaṃ'va paripakkaṃ, mahāgaṇḍo mahāvaṇo.
bhikkhussa ṭhit'okāsaṃ vā nisinn'okāsaṃ vā nipann'okāsaṃ vā āgantvā mantentaṃ ukkāsitabbaṃ, vijānāpetabbaṃ, no ce ukkāseyya vā vijānāpeyya vā, āpatti pācittiyassa.

14034.meaning1: coughed; cleared one's throat; hawked up

examples.text: bhūtapubbaṃ samaṇo gotamo anekasatāya parisāya dhammaṃ desesi. tatr'aññataro samaṇassa gotamassa sāvako ukkāsi. tam'en'āññataro sabrahmacārī jaṇṇukena ghaṭṭesi, appasaddo āyasmā hotu, m'āyasmā saddam'akāsi, satthā no bhagavā dhammaṃ desesī'ti.

14035.meaning2: pad of cloth (for rubbing the body)

examples.text: yasmiṃ samaye samaṇo gotamo anekasatāya parisāya dhammaṃ deseti, n'eva tasmiṃ samaye samaṇassa gotamassa sāvakānaṃ khipitasaddo vā hoti ukkāsitasaddo vā.

14038.meaning1: should cough; should clear one's throat

examples.text: bhikkhussa ṭhit'okāsaṃ vā nisinn'okāsaṃ vā nipann'okāsaṃ vā āgantvā mantentaṃ ukkāsitabbaṃ, vijānāpetabbaṃ, no ce ukkāseyya vā vijānāpeyya vā, āpatti pācittiyassa.

14039.meaning1: sound of a cough; coughing noise

examples.text: yasmiṃ samaye samaṇo gotamo anekasatāya parisāya dhammaṃ deseti, n'eva tasmiṃ samaye samaṇassa gotamassa sāvakānaṃ khipitasaddo vā hoti ukkāsitasaddo vā.

14040.meaning1: having coughed; having cleared one's throat

examples.text: atha kho ambaṭṭho māṇavo yena so vihāro saṃvutadvāro, tena appasaddo upasaṅkamitvā ataramāno āḷindaṃ pavisitvā ukkāsitvā aggaḷaṃ ākoṭesi. vivari bhagavā dvāraṃ.
atha kho bhagavā kathāpariyosānaṃ viditvā ukkāsitvā aggaḷaṃ ākoṭesi.
evaṃ su te ukkiṇṇaparikhāsu okkhittapalighāsu nagar'ūpakārikāsu dīghāsi'vudhehi purisehi rakkhāpenti, seyyathā'pi tvaṃ eta'r'ahi sācariyako'ti? no h'idaṃ, bho gotama.
seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, kumbho ukkujjo tatra udakaṃ āsittaṃ saṇṭhāti no vivaṭṭati

14045.meaning1: (of a bowl) uprights; turns face up
14045.meaning2: holds or sets upright; holds or sets the right way up; especially turns (the bowl) the right way up (to accept food again from a layman whose alms had been refused)

examples.text: atha kho bhagavā bhikkhū āmantesi, tena hi, bhikkhave, saṅgho vaḍḍhassa licchavissa pattaṃ ukkujjatu, sambhogaṃ saṅghena karotu.

14047.meaning2: setting upright; turning the right way up

14048.meaning2: setting up and upsetting; rise and fall

14049.meaning1: up and down; (comm) arising and passing (of)
14049.commentary: (SNa) ukkujj'āvakujjan'ti ettha ukkujjaṃ vuccati udayo, avakujjaṃ vayo'ti udayabbayavasena parivattento sammasanto'ti dīpeti.

examples.text: so khv'āhaṃ, bhante, suññ'āgāragato imesaṃ pañc'upādānakkhandhānaṃ ukkujj'āvakujjaṃ samparivattento idaṃ dukkhan'ti yathābhūtaṃ abbhaññāsiṃ, ayaṃ dukkhasamudayo'ti yathābhūtaṃ abbhaññāsiṃ, ayaṃ dukkhanirodho'ti yathābhūtaṃ abbhaññāsiṃ, ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadā'ti yathābhūtaṃ abbhaññāsiṃ.
atha kho bhagavā taṃ udak'ādhānaṃ ukkujjitvā āyasmantaṃ rāhulaṃ āmantesi, passasi no tvaṃ, rāhula, imaṃ udak'ādhānaṃ rittaṃ tucchan'ti? evaṃ, bhante.
seyyathā'pi, bho gotama, nikkujjitaṃ vā ukkujjeyya, paṭicchannaṃ vā vivareyya, mūḷhassa vā maggaṃ ācikkheyya, andhakāre vā telapajjotaṃ dhāreyya, cakkhumanto rūpāni dakkhantī'ti.
na naggacariyā na jaṭā na paṅkā, n'ānāsakā thaṇḍilasāyikā vā, rajojallaṃ ukkuṭikappadhānaṃ, sodhenti maccaṃ avitiṇṇakaṅkhaṃ.

kesamassulocako'pi hoti kesamassulocan'ānuyogam'anuyutto, ubbhaṭṭhako'pi hoti āsanappaṭikkhitto, ukkuṭiko'pi hoti ukkuṭikappadhānam'anuyutto, kaṇṭak'āpassayiko'pi hoti kaṇṭak'āpassaye seyyaṃ kappeti, sāyatatiyakam'pi udak'orohan'ānuyogam'anuyutto viharati.

14055.meaning1: ascetic who remains in the squatting posture

examples.text: kesamassulocako'pi hoti kesamassulocan'ānuyogam'anuyutto, ubbhaṭṭhako'pi hoti āsanappaṭikkhitto, ukkuṭiko'pi hoti ukkuṭikappadhānam'anuyutto, kaṇṭak'āpassayiko'pi hoti kaṇṭak'āpassaye seyyaṃ kappeti, sāyatatiyakam'pi udak'orohan'ānuyogam'anuyutto viharati.

14056.commentary: (MNa) ukkuṭikappadhānam'anuyutto'ti ukkuṭikavīriyaṃ anuyutto, gacchanto'pi ukkuṭiko'va hutvā uppatitvā uppatitvā gacchati.

examples.text: na naggacariyā na jaṭā na paṅkā, n'ānāsakā thaṇḍilasāyikā vā, rajojallaṃ ukkuṭikappadhānaṃ, sodhenti maccaṃ avitiṇṇakaṅkhaṃ.

kesamassulocako'pi hoti kesamassulocan'ānuyogam'anuyutto, ubbhaṭṭhako'pi hoti āsanappaṭikkhitto, ukkuṭiko'pi hoti ukkuṭikappadhānam'anuyutto, kaṇṭak'āpassayiko'pi hoti kaṇṭak'āpassaye seyyaṃ kappeti, sāyatatiyakam'pi udak'orohan'ānuyogam'anuyutto viharati.

14057.meaning1: devoted to the ascetic practice of remaining in the squatting posture
14057.commentary: (MNa) ukkuṭikappadhānam'anuyutto'ti ukkuṭikavīriyaṃ anuyutto, gacchanto'pi ukkuṭiko'va hutvā uppatitvā uppatitvā gacchati.

examples.text: kesamassulocako'pi hoti kesamassulocan'ānuyogam'anuyutto, ubbhaṭṭhako'pi hoti āsanappaṭikkhitto, ukkuṭiko'pi hoti ukkuṭikappadhānam'anuyutto, kaṇṭak'āpassayiko'pi hoti kaṇṭak'āpassaye seyyaṃ kappeti, sāyatatiyakam'pi udak'orohan'ānuyogam'anuyutto viharati.

14060.grammar: ind, adv, acc sg of ukkuṭika

examples.text: tena kuṭikārakena bhikkhunā kuṭivatthuṃ sodhetvā saṅghaṃ upasaṅkamitvā ek'aṃsaṃ uttar'āsaṅgaṃ karitvā vuḍḍhānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ pāde vanditvā ukkuṭikaṃ nisīditvā añjaliṃ paggahetvā evam'assa vacanīyo
navakena bhikkhunā ek'aṃsaṃ uttar'āsaṅgaṃ karitvā ukkuṭikaṃ nisīditvā añjaliṃ paggahetvā evam'assa vacanīyo

14061.meaning1: walking on tip toes; walking on the heels
14061.commentary: (VINa) ukkuṭikāyā'ti ettha ukkuṭikā vuccati paṇhiyo ukkhipitvā aggapādehi vā, aggapāde vā ukkhipitvā paṇhīhi'y'eva vā bhūmiṃ phusantassa gamanaṃ. karaṇavacanaṃ pan'ettha vuttalakkhaṇam'eva.

examples.text: na ukkuṭikāya antaraghare gamissāmī'ti sikkhā karaṇīyā.
na ukkuṭikāya antaraghare gantabbaṃ. yo anādariyaṃ paṭicca ukkuṭikāya antaraghare gacchati, āpatti dukkaṭassa.
tena kho pana samayena aññatarā bhikkhunī asaṅkaccikā gāmaṃ piṇḍāya pāvisi. tassā rathikāya vātamaṇḍalikā saṅghāṭiyo ukkhipiṃsu. manussā ukkuṭṭhiṃ akaṃsu, sundarā ayyāya than'udarā'ti.
seyyathā'pi, brāhmaṇa, udapatto agginā santatto ukkudhito ussadakajāto. tattha cakkhumā puriso sakaṃ mukhanimittaṃ paccavekkhamāno yathābhūtaṃ nappajāneyya na passeyya.

seyyathā'pi, ānanda, āsabhacammaṃ saṅkusatena suvihataṃ vigatavalikaṃ, evam'eva kho, ānanda, bhikkhu yaṃ imissā pathaviyā ukkūlavikkūlaṃ nadīviduggaṃ khāṇukaṇṭakaṭṭhānaṃ pabbatavisamaṃ taṃ sabbaṃ amanasikaritvā pathavīsaññaṃ paṭicca manasi karoti ekattaṃ.

14068.meaning1: hills and dales; mountains and valleys
14068.meaning2: rising and descending; high and low; uneven
14068.commentary: (ANa) ukkūlavikūlan'ti ukkūlañ'ca vikūlañ'ca. tattha ukkūlaṃ unnataṭṭhānaṃ, vikūlaṃ ninnaṭṭhānaṃ.

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, appamattakaṃ imasmiṃ jambudīpe ārāmarāmaṇeyyakaṃ vanarāmaṇeyyakaṃ bhūmirāmaṇeyyakaṃ pokkharaṇirāmaṇeyyakaṃ, atha kho etadeva bahutaraṃ yadidaṃ ukkūlavikūlaṃ nadīviduggaṃ khāṇukaṇṭakaṭṭhānaṃ pabbatavisamaṃ, evam'evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, appakā te sattā ye thalajā, atha kho et'eva sattā bahutarā ye odakā.

14069.meaning1: hills and dales; mountains and valleys

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, ānanda, āsabhacammaṃ saṅkusatena suvihataṃ vigatavalikaṃ, evam'eva kho, ānanda, bhikkhu yaṃ imissā pathaviyā ukkūlavikkūlaṃ nadīviduggaṃ khāṇukaṇṭakaṭṭhānaṃ pabbatavisamaṃ taṃ sabbaṃ amanasikaritvā pathavīsaññaṃ paṭicca manasi karoti ekattaṃ.

14070.meaning2: disturbance, re-opening (of a (legal) question already settled)

14071.meaning1: taking bribes; bribery; corruption; crooked dealing
14071.meaning2: perverting justice by taking bribe, etc.

examples.text: tulākūṭa kaṃsakūṭa mānakūṭa ukkoṭana vañcana nikati sāciyoga chedana vadha bandhana viparāmosa ālopa sāhasākārā paṭivirato ahosi.

14073.meaning2: consisting in re-opening (a matter already settled)

14075.meaning1: rule about re-opening (a legal case); Pācittiya 63

14077.commentary: (MNa) ukkoṭan'ādīsu ukkoṭanan'ti sāmike assāmike kātuṃ lañjaggahaṇaṃ. vañcanan'ti tehi tehi upāyehi paresaṃ vañcanaṃ.

examples.text: khettavatthupaṭiggahaṇā paṭivirato hoti, dūteyya-pahiṇagaman'ānuyogā paṭivirato hoti, kayavikkayā paṭivirato hoti, tulākūṭa-kaṃsakūṭa-mānakūṭā paṭivirato hoti, ukkoṭana-vañcana-nikati-sāciyogā paṭivirato hoti, chedana-vadha-bandhana-viparāmosa-ālopa-sahasākārā paṭivirato hoti

14078.meaning1: bribing, defrauding, counterfeiting and dishonest dealing; (comm) crooked dealing by bribery, fraud and counterfeiting
14078.compound: dvanda (ukkoṭana ca vañcana ca nikati ca sāciyoga ca)
14078.commentary: (DNa) sāciyogo'ti kuṭilayogo, etesaṃ'y'eva ukkoṭan'ādīnam'etaṃ nāmaṃ. tasmā, ukkoṭanasāciyogo, vañcanasāciyogo, nikatisāciyogo'ti, evam'ettha attho daṭṭhabbo. keci aññaṃ dassetvā aññassa parivattanaṃ sāciyogo'ti vadanti. taṃ pana vañcanen'eva saṅgahitaṃ.

examples.text: dūteyya-pahiṇagaman'ānuyogā paṭivirato ahosiṃ, kayavikkayā paṭivirato ahosiṃ, tulākūṭakaṃsakūṭamānakūṭā paṭivirato ahosiṃ, ukkoṭana-vañcana-nikati-sāciyogā paṭivirato ahosiṃ

14079.meaning2: opened up again a legal question that has been settled

14080.meaning2: opens up again a legal question that has been settled
14080.commentary: (VIN 2.5.7.3) punakammāya ukkoṭeyyā'ti, akataṃ kammaṃ dukkaṭaṃ kammaṃ punakātabbaṃ kammaṃ anihataṃ dunnihataṃ puna nihanitabbaṃ'ti ukkoṭeti

examples.text: yo pana bhikkhu jānaṃ yathādhammaṃ nihat'ādhikaraṇaṃ punakammāya ukkoṭeyya, pācittiyaṃ.

14081.meaning2: opened up again a legal question that has been settled

examples.text: so mā cintayitthā'ti vatvā na taṇḍulehī'ti kaṇikaṃ gāhāpetvā, na udakenā'ti himaṃ gāhāpetvā, na ukkhaliyā'ti aññaṃ navamattikābhājanaṃ gāhāpetvā, na uddhanenā'ti khāṇuke koṭṭāpetvā, na agginā'ti pakati-aggiṃ pahāya araṇi-aggiṃ gāhāpetvā, na dārūhī'ti paṇṇāni gāhāpetvā ambil'odanaṃ pacāpetvā

14084.commentary: (THIa) ukkhalikā me deḍḍubhaṃ vātī'ti me mama bhattapacanabhājanaṃ cirapārivāsikabhāvena aparisuddhatāya udakasappagandhaṃ vāyati, tato ahaṃ sādhumuttik'āmhī'ti yojanā.

examples.text: sumuttikā sumuttikā, sādhumuttik'āmhi musalassa, ahiriko me chattakaṃ vā'pi, ukkhalikā me deḍḍubhaṃ vāti.
jiṇṇam'pi, bhikkhave, potthakaṃ ukkhaliparimajjanaṃ vā karonti saṅkārakūṭe vā naṃ chaḍḍenti.

14086.meaning1: rim and lid of a pot

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, sāmuddikāya nāvāya vettabandhanabaddhāya vassamāsāni udake pariyādāya hem'antikena thalaṃ ukkhittāya vāt'ātapaparetāni vettabandhanāni.
puriso ca te ukkhitta-asiko piṭṭhito piṭṭhito anubandhissati. yatth'eva naṃ thokam'pi chaḍḍessati tatth'eva te siro pātessatī'ti.

14090.commentary: (VIN) ukkhitto nāma āpattiyā adassane vā appaṭikamme vā appaṭinissagge vā ukkhitto.

examples.text: akaṭ'ānudhammo nāma ukkhitto anosārito.
puggal'ānādariyaṃ nāma upasampannena paññattena vuccamāno ayaṃ ukkhittako vā vambhito vā garahito vā, imassa vacanaṃ akataṃ bhavissatī'ti anādariyaṃ karoti, āpatti pācittiyassa.
saṃvaseyya vā'ti ukkhittakena saddhiṃ uposathaṃ vā pavāraṇaṃ vā saṅghakammaṃ vā karoti, āpatti pācittiyassa.

14093.meaning1: (of a robe) lifted up; pulled up; hoisted up
14093.commentary: (VINa) ukkhittakāyā'ti ukkhepena, ittham'bhūtalakkhaṇe karaṇavacanaṃ ekato vā ubhato vā ukkhittacīvaro hutvā'ti attho.

examples.text: na ukkhittakāya antaraghare gamissāmī'ti sikkhā karaṇīyā.

14094.meaning1: rule about re-admitting a suspended monastic

examples.text: ukkhittake ukkhittakasaññī sambhuñjati vā saṃvasati vā saha vā seyyaṃ kappeti, āpatti pācittiyassa.

14097.meaning1: who has raised the crossbar; who has lifted the obstacle
14097.commentary: (DHPa) idaṃ sabbam'pi chinditvā ṭhitaṃ avijjāpalighassa ukkhittattā ukkhittapalighaṃ

examples.text: chetvā naddhiṃ varattañ'ca, sandānaṃ sah'anukkamaṃ, ukkhittapalighaṃ buddhaṃ, tam'ahaṃ brūmi brāhmaṇaṃ.
ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, bhikkhu ukkhittapaligho iti'pi, saṃkiṇṇaparikkho iti'pi, abbūḷh'esiko iti'pi, niraggaḷo iti'pi, ariyo pannaddhajo pannabhāro visaṃyutto iti'pi.

14098.meaning1: rule about sharing with a suspended (monk); Pācittiya 69

14099.meaning2: (one) with a drawn sword; with sword raised
